prompt_recommendations.title: Enforce non-empty opening turn with mandatory question stem
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The system produced no visible tutor output at all, despite the opener instruction requiring an immediate greeting and posed question.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: Begin the lesson. Greet the student briefly, name what they'll learn in one short sentence, then immediately pose the first warm-up question via pose_question
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'Your FIRST reply MUST contain (1) a one-line greeting, (2) a one-sentence lesson goal, and (3) the full question stem with all options rendered inline as visible text. Never respond with an empty message or a tool call alone — always include visible text alongside any tool use.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Guarantees the student sees a warm-up question on turn 1 rather than a blank/empty tutor turn.

prompt_recommendations.title: Require visible text accompaniment for every tool call
prompt_recommendations.rationale: If pose_question was called silently, the student would see nothing. The prompt should forbid tool-only turns.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: include the full question stem (and A/B/C/D options for MCQ) in your visible text reply
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add rule: 'Every tool invocation must be paired with a visible message that restates the question stem and options. A tool call without accompanying visible text is a protocol violation.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevents silent tool calls that leave the student with no content on screen.

prompt_recommendations.title: Handle 'let's try again' recovery explicitly
prompt_recommendations.rationale: Student asked 'what was your answer to the last question?' indicating a broken prior state. The prompt should specify a recovery script.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: let's try again. what was your answer to the last question?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'If the student references a prior question that is not in your visible context, acknowledge the gap, re-pose a fresh warm-up question of appropriate difficulty, and do NOT fabricate a previous answer.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Gives the tutor a deterministic recovery path when session state is lost.

flow_recommendations.title: Detect and retry empty tutor turns
flow_recommendations.rationale: The orchestration allowed the tutor to produce zero visible content on the opener; a validator should catch this.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: Begin the lesson. ... just open and pose.
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Empty or tool-only opening turns are auto-retried before display, ensuring the student always receives a stem.

flow_recommendations.title: Persist last-posed-question in session state
flow_recommendations.rationale: Student's turn 6 implies loss of question context; the engine should surface the last pose_question payload back into the tutor's context on continuation.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: what was your answer to the last question?
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Enables graceful continuation of interrupted sessions without hallucinating prior content.

experience_recommendations.title: Show a fallback message on empty tutor response
experience_recommendations.rationale: The student experienced silence, which is disorienting and unhelpful.
experience_recommendations.expected_effect: Student sees an explicit 'Let me re-open the lesson' message rather than emptiness.
